_readme: THE STANDING TRIGGER CENSUS. Every non-internal trigger in every non-system schema of the MAIN database, one row per trigger as `schema.table|trigger_name|schema.function`, read off pg_trigger with tgparentid = 0 so a partitioned table's trigger is counted ONCE, on the relation it was declared on. It exists so the STATIC arm of scripts/check-inverses-leave-the-ground-standing.ts -- which has no database and is the release gate -- can see a trigger that no file under migrations/ creates any more. Regenerate with `pnpm check:inverses-leave-the-ground-standing:record-census` against the main database; the recorder REFUSES to shrink the file without --allow-shrink. NEVER hand-edit: a row removed here is a trigger the guard stops watching, which is exactly the blindness this file closes.
source: aws-1-us-east-1.pooler.supabase.com/postgres — pg_trigger join pg_class join pg_namespace join pg_proc, tgisinternal = false, every schema except pg_catalog and information_schema
